topic: 面向光子芯片智能设计的三方向技术调研
format_promise: A clean, editable PowerPoint deck with one dominant idea per slide, disciplined alignment, and enough visual rhythm to avoid generic card grids.
anti_format: repeated title plus three cards on every slide
body text placed by feel instead of grid constants
decorative shapes without a reading job
shrinking text below readability floors to solve density

canvas_and_grid.header_policy: measured title/subtitle stack; body starts at returned contentTop
canvas_and_grid.column_policy: derive columns from margin and gutter constants, not magic numbers

palette_role_map.accent: navigation, KPI emphasis, rails, and labels

title_page_concept.supporting_element: short subtitle or one strong hero asset
title_page_concept.why_this_could_only_be_this_deck: 封面明确列出 DAS、光子人工智能计算与 Agentic PIC 三个导师目标，并注明证据截止日期。

structure_strategy.primary_scaffold: open editorial content slides with measured headers
allowed_variations: timeline only when the sequence is truly time-based
optional kpi-hero only when one metric deserves isolation
structure_strategy.container_policy: Cards are for modular comparisons or evidence groups, not the default way to make prose look designed.
structure_strategy.rhythm_break_plan: Use a rhythm break only when the content asks for it: a true hero metric, a full-bleed/source-backed image, a major section turn, or a decisive chart. Do not add a KPI hero just to break rhythm. Do not add a timeline just because a slide has steps; use report bands, a table, or a figure when those are clearer.
